source: UNIQA Postman collections 'XSD valid risk factor requests' (IDs 900). The requests are XSD-valid samples: several differ from each other only in names and do not trigger the factor they are named after.
note: Keys are the factor names from the file names (RFnn_<Factor>.xml), shared by personal and corporate. The collection files stay as delivered; `fields` are sent on top of them.

presentOnly.CustomerTypeRisk: Individual customers and legal entities both weigh 0 on QA (3 Nov 2026); QA values are leading (Gert, 3 Nov 2026).

acceptedOnly.ManualRiskAdjustment: The IFS XSD has no manual risk adjustment tag: it is set in the UI, not over REST.
acceptedOnly.DisclosureRisk: ODD risk contributor, not CDD: no contribution from a REST request is correct (Gert, 3 Nov 2026).

pending.GeographicRisk: New info list to be sent by UNIQA (Gert, 3 Nov 2026). Postal code 95000 / AQ gives 'Geographic Location:' with no value.
pending.ResidencyRisk: New info list to be sent by UNIQA (Gert, 3 Nov 2026). ResidenceFlag N and Y give 'Customer is a resident:' with no value.
